title: PMR: Fast Application Response via Parallel Memory Reclaim on Mobile Devices
problem: Mobile applications experience latency spikes during memory reclamation operations that block execution. Sequential memory management on multi-core mobile processors underutilizes available parallelism for reclamation tasks.
motivation: Responsive mobile applications are critical for user experience, and memory reclamation pauses cause noticeable frame drops and input lag that degrade perceived performance.
method: PMR parallelizes memory scanning and reclamation across multiple processor cores using coordinated threads. The system employs lock-free mechanisms to minimize synchronization overhead and uses heuristics to prioritize less frequently accessed memory regions for reclamation.
key_novelty: Parallel coordination of memory reclamation across mobile multi-core processors to eliminate sequential garbage collection bottlenecks.
contributions: Parallel memory reclamation framework optimized for mobile platforms
Lock-free synchronization primitives for concurrent memory management
Priority-based heuristic for selecting reclamation regions
Demonstrated reduction in application response latency
limitations: Paper scope and experimental limitations not discussed in title; requires full abstract and content review.
primary_theme: Parallel memory reclamation for mobile responsiveness
